 Trenton High School to host FAFSA Night for area seniors
 Local News October 21, 2026 KTTN News Click the + Icon To See Additional Sharing Options   1                             1 Share 
 The Trenton High School counseling department will host a FAFSA Night on Wednesday, Nov. 4, from 5:30 to 7 p.m. in the school’s library media center. The event is open to high school seniors throughout the area and their parents who want to learn more about college scholarships and financial aid opportunities. 
 The event is being organized in partnership with the North Central Missouri College (NCMC) Financial Aid Office. Representatives will be available to guide students and their families through the process of completing the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA), which is used to determine eligibility for federal student financial assistance. 
 Families seeking additional information about FAFSA Night or the application process may contact Trenton High School. 
 Mary Woodson, RootED advisor at Trenton High School, provided the event information.
